dedupe_keys.name: great britain s primary substation service areas and annual domestic energy statistics

description: Joseph Day and Grant Wilson publish service-area polygons for 4,436 primary substations in Great Britain, assembled from six distribution network operators. A streamlined GeoJSON contains identifiers, names, licence areas and local authorities; a richer GeoJSON and CSV add aggregated domestic energy statistics. Coordinates use WGS84. Meter counts and consumption are means for 2015–2020, while the polygon inputs reflect availability during 2021–2022. The November 2023 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0, with the source operators' permission recorded by the authors. These areas can allocate residential demand and support spatial energy-system or infrastructure-exposure simulations. Service polygons and period averages do not establish individual customer connections or current network loading. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The deposited tables and geometries were not downloaded or checked for topology errors.
